title: Full learned multimodal PLM with SwiLA-derived multi-timescale persistent state
question: Can the full PLM computational loop learn multimodal representation, persistent multi-timescale state, relevance routing, structural computation, action, verification, repair, and verified state update end to end?

architecture.representation: learned text convolutional encoder + learned spatial image encoder + learned temporal-frequency audio encoder + multimodal fusion
architecture.persistent_state: SwiLA-derived mixture of linear regressors with fast/medium/slow retention bands, temporal responsibilities, learned input-dependent decay, and verified experience writes
architecture.cdl: learned sparse routing over persistent expert views
architecture.casm: learned structural workspace plus learned operator bank with top-k sparse operator routing and adaptive halting; no fixed semantic operators
architecture.osm: learned action-conditioned latent transition predictor and learned Hamiltonian energy
architecture.action: learned policy/planner combining CASM state with action-conditioned OSM predictions
architecture.verifier: learned verifier of pre/post learned state plus continuous post-action outcome evidence; binary success is not an input
architecture.repair: learned repair action proposal executed after verifier rejection
architecture.state_update: persistent write gated by verifier; hard gate at inference, differentiable verifier probability during training

swiLA_boundary.use: candidate recurrent state kernel and MTSK mechanism
not_claimed: SwiLA evidence transfers as PLM evidence
the MTSK mapping is established without a PLM experiment

allowed_information: Hamilton canonical equations dq/dt=dH/dp and dp/dt=-dH/dq
conservation of a learned Hamiltonian on passive intervals

benchmark_integrity.hidden_state: used only by environment generator and outcome computation
benchmark_integrity.history_pairs: same current multimodal observation but different preceding histories and different optimal action
benchmark_integrity.evaluation_reuse_between_arms: not applicable; this is a single integrated construction run
benchmark_integrity.model_outcome_input: continuous post-action distance-to-goal evidence; binary success never enters model
benchmark_integrity.repair_execution: failed first action may trigger one learned repair action applied to the resulting environment state
benchmark_integrity.generator_hash_rule: SHA-256 of benchmark generator file bytes

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass and mean action accuracy >= 0.70; every seed >= 0.55; mean history-pair exact >= 0.70; mean closed-loop success >= 0.70
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that the integrated full learned PLM is functional, including executable verification/repair/state-update behavior, on the registered multimodal physical-control benchmark
decision_rule.does_not_license: ablation causality, real-world competence, general intelligence, or asymptotic scaling

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but one or more full-PLM capability thresholds fails
decision_rule.licenses: the integrated PLM construction is not yet demonstrated on the registered benchmark

ablation_policy.run_only_after: full_plm_gate=true with all integrity gates passing
ablation_policy.method: one architecture with controlled mechanism switches
ablation_policy.primary_question: causal responsibility of persistence, CDL, CASM, OSM, verifier, repair, and plasticity within the integrated model

amendments.change: Verifier receives continuous post-action outcome evidence plus learned pre/post representations; binary success is external supervision only and never a model input.
amendments.old_definition: Verifier originally received a simpler signal definition that did not explicitly bind it to continuous post-action consequence evidence.
amendments.new_definition: Verifier receives continuous post-action distance-to-goal outcome evidence plus learned pre/post representations; binary success remains external supervision only and never enters the model.
amendments.rationale: Close the verifier information boundary so the model can use observable consequence without receiving the benchmark's binary answer label.
amendments.affected: verifier input schema and training target boundary

amendments.change: Learned repair is executed as a second environment action after a failed first action; closed-loop success is added to the primary full-PLM gate.
amendments.old_definition: Repair was initially specified as a learned proposal but was not yet required to be executed in the environment after a failed first action.
amendments.new_definition: A failed first action may trigger one learned repair action, which is executed from the resulting environment state; closed-loop success is a primary capability gate component.
amendments.rationale: The full PLM claim includes action, outcome, verification, and repair, so repair must be executable rather than a non-operative prediction head.

amendments.change: Benchmark generator hash is computed directly from its source file bytes; the generator provenance test asserts this identity.
amendments.old_definition: Benchmark generator provenance was represented by a source hash rule that was not yet regression-tested against the actual file bytes.
amendments.new_definition: Benchmark generator provenance is the SHA-256 of the benchmark generator file bytes, with a focused regression test asserting the identity.
amendments.rationale: Prevent silent benchmark-generator drift between the pinned experiment design and the executed benchmark.
amendments.affected: benchmark provenance check only; no semantic benchmark rule change

amendments.change: CASM execution is top-k sparse at runtime (casm_top_k=1) rather than evaluating the complete learned operator bank; MTSK retention combines learned fast/medium/slow base decay with an input-dependent retention gate.
amendments.old_definition: CASM could evaluate the complete learned operator bank and MTSK decay was not yet explicitly input-dependent.
amendments.new_definition: CASM executes only the registered top-k=1 routed operators at runtime, and MTSK combines fixed fast/medium/slow base retention with a learned input-dependent retention gate.
amendments.rationale: Make selective computation and adaptive persistence part of the actual executable model rather than descriptive intent.
amendments.affected: CASM runtime sparsity and MTSK dynamics

amendments.change: Integrity is extended from within-seed train/eval overlap to pairwise cross-seed train/eval overlap and contamination checks between the held-out history-pair set and all train/eval pools, plus cross-seed history-pair overlap.
amendments.old_definition: Integrity initially checked only within-seed train/evaluation disjointness.
amendments.new_definition: Integrity also requires zero cross-seed train overlap, cross-seed evaluation overlap, history-pair contamination with all train/evaluation pools, and cross-seed history-pair overlap.
amendments.rationale: Prevent repeated benchmark instances across independent seeds or leakage of held-out history-pair examples into training/evaluation pools.

amendments.old_definition: The benchmark Git blob pin referenced the generator before a lint-only unused-import removal.
amendments.new_definition: The benchmark Git blob pin is refreshed to the exact post-lint generator blob 42cd765194492a06bc2180bf2c9462c973ab73d6; generator semantics and episode construction are unchanged.
amendments.rationale: A provenance pin must identify the exact bytes that the measured run imports, even for a non-semantic source edit.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: no measurement was run under the stale byte-level provenance pin

amendments.old_definition: The physics-prior implementation requested autograd derivatives with respect to q and p view tensors produced by chunking the canonical latent, which PyTorch rejected as unused graph inputs during the first attempted full measurement.
amendments.new_definition: The physics-prior implementation differentiates the learned Hamiltonian with respect to the full canonical latent and then splits that gradient into q and p components.
amendments.rationale: Correct the executable implementation of the preregistered Hamiltonian prior without changing the allowed information, benchmark, training schedule, optimizer, or decision rule.
amendments.discovered: during first attempted full measurement; before any valid result artifact
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: the failed run terminated before any result artifact and is invalid for scientific interpretation

hypothesis: A single fully learned multimodal PLM with persistent multi-timescale state, learned relevance routing, learned structural computation, action-conditioned OSM planning, learned verification, learned repair, and verifier-gated state update should learn the registered held-out physical-control task without task-specific operator, addressing, or state-ontology scaffolds.

arms.name: full_plm
arms.intervention: full integrated learned PLM path with all preregistered components enabled
